sources.scope: Actual Lemma4.8 normalized-curvature numerical interface only. The actual f=V_eta smoothing/C2/curvature producer is a separate prerequisite before claiming the fully instantiated source lemma. No measure-level contraction, Khat/Kbar bias/variance, local discretization, invariance, history/expected query cost, Wp/proxy-warmness/initialization, PBPS or either full main/composition result is proved here. TV closeness cannot transfer unbounded expected cost.

assumptions: E is a complete finite-dimensional real inner-product Borel space, including dimension zero. f:E->R is globally C2, kappa>=1, and its genuine nested second derivative satisfies (2kappa)^-1||v||^2<=D2f(z)[v,v]<=||v||^2 for every z,v. This is the explicit normalized smoothed-potential interface; the actual f=V_eta producer remains independently open.

J>=2,h>0. Actual Chebyshev-Lobatto nodes t_j=h/2(1-cos(j*pi/(J-1))), cardinal polynomials ell_j and ordinary Lebesgue integral weights omega_ij=integral_0^t_i(t_i-s)ell_j(s)ds, b_j=integral_0^h ell_j(s)ds,c_j=integral_0^h(h-s)ell_j(s)ds. Lambda=sup_[0,h] sum_j|ell_j| and h Lambda<=1/(65536 kappa). No supplied convenient weights, Hessian, phase or remainder certificate.

a=exp(-h/2),sigma=sqrt(1-exp(-h)); P0=a p+sigma zeta0; Y0_j=x+t_j P0; Y1_i=Y0_i-sum_j omega_ij gradient f(Y0_j); Phi=(x+hP0-sum_j c_j gradient f(Y1_j),a(P0-sum_j b_j gradient f(Y1_j))+sigma zeta1). The same two noise vectors are shared by the two inputs. The inequality is for every z,zprime,zeta, not only almost surely.

Q_kappa(x,p)=((2kappa)^-1+1/2)||x||^2+inner(x,p)+||p||^2. The source M_kappa norm is sqrt Q. Intermediate Euclidean phase norms are the true WithLp2 product; the ordinary product max norm is not substituted.
units.statement: For the actual full exact-gradient two-refresh two-Picard Phi, the synchronous increment difference obeys sqrt Q_kappa((Phi_z-Phi_zprime)-(z-zprime)) <=12 h sqrt Q_kappa(z-zprime), under the explicit normalized C2 curvature interface and actual h Lambda<=1/(65536 kappa). This is the source difference of increments because vector subtraction is additive. The source universal C is explicitly elaborated as12, with the same c1/65536 as the actual contraction. All compared states and common noise values are included.

steps.title: Consume the actual numerical expansion
steps.text: The compiled actual source coefficient constructor gives Lambda>=1. Derive h<=1 and h²Lambda<=1 from the stated source step condition. Then apply the actual FirstOrderDifference constructor to this same Phi, exact source coefficients and genuine gradient. For each compared input/noise, it produces a symmetric actual segment-averaged H, ||H||op<=1, and an internally constructed R, with q=d+h A_H d+Rd and ||R||op<=8Lambda h². No H or R is a public hypothesis.
steps.lean: hcoeff; hLambda; hs; hfirst; hp; heq; hR

steps.title: Control the genuine drift and remainder
steps.text: From kappa>=1 and hLambda<=1/(65536kappa), derive 8hLambda<=1. The actual remainder therefore satisfies ||Rd||2<=h||d||2. The operator norm bound gives ||Hd_x||<=||d_x||. Decompose the true Euclidean product into its two coordinate axes and use the triangle inequality to obtain ||A_Hd||2<=||d_x||+2||d_p||<=3||d||2. These calculations remain inline inside this real consumer; no copied background theorem receives separate credit.
steps.lean: hsmall; hrprime; hHx; hAp; hA; WithLp.norm_toLp_fst; WithLp.norm_toLp_snd

steps.title: Bound the actual synchronous increment
steps.text: Subtract d from the actual expansion. The norm of h A_Hd+Rd is at most h times3||d||2 plus h||d||2. Common noise cancellation is already established in the actual expansion parent; it is not assumed for an abstract phase.

steps.title: Reuse the exact original source metric comparisons
steps.text: Call the existing unchanged public source APIs. They prove ||v||2²<=6Q(v) and Q(v)<=3||v||2²/2. Hence Q(q-d)<=24h²||d||2²<=144h²Q(d). Both comparisons use the original exact Q, not a replacement metric or supplied coercivity certificate.

steps.title: Take square roots without dividing by displacement
steps.text: The lower comparison proves Q(d)>=0 and Q(q-d)>=0 even when d=0 or the space has dimension zero. Using squared square-root identities and nonnegative h, take square roots of the previous inequality. This yields12h sqrt Q(d); no strictly positive displacement is needed. Reordering coordinate subtraction identifies q-d with the source difference of increments.
